name: Mystrika
summary: Cold-email outreach platform with inbox warmup, sender rotation, A/B testing and AI personalization, priced by prospect slots with a free plan.
best_for: founders, agencies and small sales teams that run cold outreach from many mailboxes and want warmup, rotation and AI help under one fixed price
skip_if: you need a CRM, a very large prospect database included, or you cannot meet the consent and opt-out rules for cold email in your market
honest_knock: Pricing is by prospect slots, so a large list pushes you up a plan quickly: 500 on Free, 2,500 on Growth. The site claims high inbox placement and reply-rate gains in its own copy; we have not tested these. The FAQ states a soft limit of 299 sending addresses and 100 warmup emails per address per day. Cold email carries legal duties that vary by country.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Growth · Growth billed monthly, 2,500 prospect slots, unlimited senders and warmup, no monthly sending limit
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on mystrika.com) Mystrika is a cold-email platform that sells by prospect slots rather than by sender count. Free Forever costs $0, needs no card and gives 500 prospect slots, up to 50 senders, unlimited warmup, A/B testing and a daily deliverability status. Growth costs $30 a month, or $16 a month billed annually, and gives 2,500 prospect slots with unlimited senders and warmup, a unified inbox (Unibox), seven warmup languages and six warmup types. Dominate costs $85 a month, or $70 a month billed annually, and gives 30,000 prospect slots plus workspaces and teams, MCP, API and webhooks, Provider Match, subsequences, AI personalization and sentiment, and an AI sequence creator and rewriter. Rampage costs $300 a month, or $210 a month billed annually, and gives 100,000 prospect slots plus whitelabel, extensive analytics, macros and templates, and priority support. The page says annual billing is 35% off. The pages states that Mystrika does not limit the number of emails sent per month. Prices are in dollars as shown.
